poc_objectives: Validate throughput guarantees for reserved GPU pools at target qps (200 qps embeddings; 150 qps chat completions)
Prove latency SLOs: 99th percentile request latency < 200ms for representative reranking prompts; P50/P95 targets also documented
Size reserved GPU commitment (min GPUs vs burst) based on 95th/99th usage profiles
Confirm autoscale and graceful fallback behaviour under instance failures
Demonstrate KMS integration and audit log delivery to Magnetar SIEM
poc_scope_and_test_matrix: Representative prompt sets: 1) short rerank (avg 16 tokens generate), 2) chat starter (avg 48 tokens), 3) embeddings (batch sizes 16/64). Test types: ramp, steady-state, soak 24h, chaos (simulate GPU OOM), network degradation. Metrics: qps, per-token latency, cold-start tail, KV-cache hit ratio, GPU utilization, memory paging events.
test_findings_and_notes: Ramp tests: linear scaling observed up to 70% GPU utilization; queuing appeared after 75% with request latency tail growth.
Soak test (24h): cache churn led to increased host memory pressure on stale models; fixed by increasing KV-cache allocation and adjusting eviction policy.
99th pctile: synthetic adversarial long-context inputs caused token generation stalling—mitigation: per-route model routing to smaller context variants as fallback.
Autoscale/Failover: graceful fallback to a slightly smaller model maintained availability but raised cost; acceptable as configured in canary policy.
Security: KMS integration proof-of-concept complete; audit logs pushed to Magnetar SIEM in near-real time (5s lag). SOC2 evidence requested for 2019 controls (ticket REDW-1740).
recommended_configuration: Start with a dedicated pool of 8x A40-equivalent GPUs with 2x burst slots for traffic spikes. Configure continuous batching at 100ms target batch window for embeddings, enable prefix caching for reranking routes, and enable automatic fallback to a quantized variant for cold caches. Include 1 week of extended soak tests post deployment before converting to reserved billing.
commercial_notes: Proposed committed monthly spend $22k-$28k with 12-month contract. Option to reserve additional burst capacity at defined uplift. Finance asking for net-30 payment terms; procurement requests SOC2 and ISO27001 confirmation before signing.
